title: Two-tier approval acknowledgements not named in extensions.md
reality: personal-extension.schema.ts:100-101 requires acknowledgeSandboxedCode: z.literal(true) on every approval, plus a SEPARATE optional acknowledgeFullPageAccess: z.literal(true) for full-page packages. references/extensions.md describes the exact-hash approval and the high-risk disclosure narratively but names neither field, so the two-tier structure is not visible.
fix: Add both field names to the approval material in references/extensions.md. The literal(true) requirement on each is the schema-level proof that the disclosure cannot be skipped programmatically — useful when a contributor asks how the gate is actually enforced rather than merely presented.

title: extensionRuntimeSchema client/server split and serverJs requirement not documented at field level
reality: personal-extension.schema.ts:44 sets runtime with default 'client'; line 61-64 enforces that runtime === 'server' requires a non-empty serverJs, raising a validation error on the serverJs path. Extension payload fields are code, css, js, serverJs, contentHash, capabilities, version. references/extensions.md covers the browser/server split conceptually but does not name the payload fields.
fix: Add a short payload-shape block to references/extensions.md listing runtime, code/js, css, serverJs, capabilities, contentHash, and version. Makes the manifest examples in that file self-consistent with the actual schema rather than illustrative-only.

title: Script-tool and webhook env vars present but worth reconfirming against 2.4.0 values
reality: docs/CONFIGURATION.md confirms CUSTOM_TOOL_SCRIPT_ENABLED default false, CUSTOM_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS default 60000 (1 minute), and WEBHOOK_LOCAL_URLS_ENABLED default false — all matching what references/custom-tools.md and decision-guide.md already state.
fix: No change needed. Verified accurate at v2.4.0; recorded so a later pass does not re-derive these.

title: Custom tool schema unchanged at 2.4.0 — enabled default still true
reality: packages/shared/src/schemas/custom-tool.schema.ts still defines executionType as webhook|static|script with enabled: z.boolean().default(true) and includeHiddenContext: z.boolean().default(false). The v2.4.0 import hardening is applied at the IMPORT path, not by changing these schema defaults — so 'imported webhooks arrive disabled' coexists with 'enabled defaults to true' without contradiction.
fix: No change needed, but worth preserving this note: the two facts look contradictory in isolation and a future pass could 'fix' one of them incorrectly.
